data.name: Petros
data.gender_notes: Petros is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'petra' meaning 'rock'. In the New Testament, Simon Peter is given the name 'Petros' by Jesus, which symbolizes his foundation of faith. The name Petros carries the meaning “Rock” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Petros usually hope their child will grow to embody rock and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Petros belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rock.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Petros total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_english.name: Petros
in_english.long_meaning: Petros is a name derived from Greek and Hebrew roots, meaning rock or large stone, and is referenced in the New Testament as the name of one of Jesus' twelve apostles, Saint Peter, who is considered one of the founders of the Christian Church

data.cultural_impact: Petros, or Peter, is a predominantly Christian name and holds significant cultural importance due to its biblical origins. It is recognized in both Eastern and Western Christian traditions, and is a popular given name in many countries, particularly in the Mediterranean region. Petros is a powerful name with an enduring legacy, reflecting its spiritual and historical significance as the name of one of the apostles and early Christian leaders.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Christian context, the name 'Petros' has deep spiritual significance. It symbolizes steadfastness, strength, and unwavering faith. As the name given to Simon by Jesus, it represents Peter's role as the 'rock' on which Christ built his Church. The significance of 'Petros' is a reminder for Christians to build their lives on a strong foundation of faith, trust, and obedience to God.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Petros, meaning "rock" in Greek, symbolically represents the foundation of faith and trust in God, as Jesus referred to Peter as the "rock upon whom I will build my church." It symbolizes strength, stability, and unwavering commitment in the face of adversity.

biblical_reference.note: Jesus says to Simon, 'You are Peter, and on this rock I will build my church'

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Petros was a disciple of Jesus Christ in the New Testament. The name Petros carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
